tranches.title: Repository, approved plan, delivery graph and edu ownership
tranches.acceptance: Plan provenance, dependency graph, remote issues and PR are published.

tranches.title: Synthetic intake and deterministic assessment contracts
tranches.acceptance: Synthetic API and privacy, rubric, evidence, retention, encryption tests pass.

tranches.title: Reproducible verification and qualification boundaries
tranches.acceptance: Clean installation, CI definition, smoke test and explicit unqualified routes exist.

tranches.title: PostgreSQL schema, migrations and scoped authorization
tranches.acceptance: Instructor, term, course, section and enrollment models survive migrate/rollback tests; cross-scope access is denied. Legacy course/realm, assignment/quest and submission references are scoped mappings; client IDs or roles grant no authority.

tranches.title: OIDC MFA, object vault and separate identity keys
tranches.acceptance: Private login works; content worker cannot decrypt identity; backup restore is demonstrated.
tranches.implementation_note: Filesystem envelope vault and mocked OIDC/PKCE browser sessions implemented; hosted KMS isolation, live issuer and PostgreSQL integration qualification pending.

tranches.title: Hosted staging, secrets and operational controls
tranches.acceptance: Synthetic staging smoke passes; budgets, logs, key rotation and rollback have executable checks.

tranches.title: DOCX PDF TXT ZIP and roster ingestion
tranches.acceptance: Bounded extraction preserves text and paragraph order; scanned, malformed, zip-bomb and ambiguous roster cases hold. Legacy import dry runs report exact source, imported, duplicate and held counts without writing historical student records.
tranches.implementation_note: Protected fixture-only extraction and version-bound passage review now connect scoped SQL metadata/audit, separate durable vaults and dashboard controls. SQL migration/transaction/RLS, HTTPS browser, PDF/OCR/parser and real-data qualification remain pending.

tranches.title: Contextual de-identification and passage mapping
tranches.acceptance: Direct identifiers and contextual disclosures tested; uncertain cases hold; original passage mapping survives redactions.
tranches.implementation_note: Protected fixture-only extraction and version-bound passage review now connect scoped SQL metadata/audit, separate durable vaults and dashboard controls. SQL migration/transaction/RLS, HTTPS browser, PDF/OCR/parser and real-data qualification remain pending.

tranches.title: Next.js intake workspace and exception resolution
tranches.acceptance: Instructor imports a whole synthetic class and resolves mismatches without cross-student disclosure. Adapt prior course, assignment, upload and reflection views after removing direct Firebase/Spark/model dependencies; demonstrate the authorized service path.
tranches.implementation_note: Protected fixture-only extraction and version-bound passage review now connect scoped SQL metadata/audit, separate durable vaults and dashboard controls. SQL migration/transaction/RLS, HTTPS browser, PDF/OCR/parser and real-data qualification remain pending.

tranches.title: Versioned rubric setup and assessment provider contract
tranches.acceptance: Instructor activates verified criteria; exact versions govern jobs; full text fits or holds; arithmetic is deterministic. Teacher Dashboard level-point, Aetheria maxPoints and Aetheria weighted-level formats import as inactive drafts; labels and provenance survive; ambiguous totals or weights hold.

tranches.title: Evidence-grounded feedback and release validation
tranches.acceptance: Unsupported quotes, conflicting feedback, prompt injection and unqualified routes cannot yield released grades. Instructor snippet insertion retains evidence obligations; reused templates cannot imply unsupported student-specific observations.

tranches.title: Review overrides and versioned export packages
tranches.acceptance: Original/feedback side-by-side review works; overrides persist; export contains only eligible student-result pairs. Preserve snippet edits and standards-mastery reporting; percentage conversion requires an explicit verified policy. Historical grades never become newly qualified results.

tranches.title: Student learning record and revision linkage
tranches.acceptance: History claims reference actual prior work; corrections invalidate derived summaries; no cross-course links. Optional student reflections retain provenance and affect feedback only unless the activated rubric explicitly assesses them.

tranches.title: Section snapshots and instructor teaching insights
tranches.acceptance: Coverage denominator is explicit; classmates' identities and raw essays are absent from personal feedback. All assignment entries, including missing and held work, are accounted for; first-five sampling and snippet usage are never presented as whole-class coverage.

tranches.title: Personalization separated from grading
tranches.acceptance: Cohort/history changes cannot alter fixed scoring inputs; progress and revision priorities remain evidence-grounded.

tranches.title: Permitted cloud route and usage accounting
tranches.acceptance: Only scrubbed authorized payloads leave; provider policy, spend caps, deadlines and request receipts are enforced. Adapted clients cannot call models directly; unavailable static/demo providers produce typed holds, not feedback, and storage/provider fallback remains explicit.

tranches.title: Mac companion with outbound leases
tranches.acceptance: Assigned jobs run locally; expired credentials fail; offline machine leaves jobs waiting; no cloud fallback.

tranches.title: Idempotency, resumable jobs and cancellation
tranches.acceptance: Injected crashes resume completed stages without duplicate exports; uncertain provider charging is reconciled without blind replay.

tranches.title: Held-out grading and feedback benchmark
tranches.acceptance: At least 50 authorized essays across assignments/sections; score and feedback thresholds pass separately per route.

tranches.title: Term cache, vault retention and deletion closure
tranches.acceptance: All cache modes, term transitions, derived records, exports and backup tombstones pass expiry/restore tests.

tranches.title: Operational rehearsal and release decision
tranches.acceptance: Load, isolation, rollback, restore and wrong-student tests pass; unresolved release gates are explicit.

tranches.title: One-assignment shadow run
tranches.acceptance: Instructor compares every pilot result; no automatic external distribution; documented error and effort measurements.

tranches.title: Multiple-section controlled pilot
tranches.acceptance: Qualified routes export full-class results; holds, overrides, costs and turnaround are measured against manifest coverage.

tranches.title: Accepted instructor release
tranches.acceptance: Whole-assignment success predicate passes; support/runbooks, recovery owner and next-term setup are demonstrated.
